de: The Federation Council approved the increase in the subsistence minimum in Russia to almost 21 thousand rubles per capita in 2027.

de: The first Russian CAR-T-cell drug "Utzhefra" for the treatment of malignant blood tumors received a license for use in medical institutions, the press service of the National Institute of Hematology of the Ministry of Health of Russia reported.

de: The French economy in the third quarter of the year decreased by 0.2% — this figure was worse than the preliminary estimate of 0.1%, and in the second quarter there was no growth, writes the Financial Times.

de: Lawyer Vladimir Hartman said that unknown small charges from a bank card after online purchases may not be a service check of the card, but an attempt by fraudsters to find out whether it is valid.

de: Therapist, occupational therapist Svetlana Burnatskaya warned that the consequences of vitamin B12, D, B1 and C deficiency can be especially serious.

de: Gazprom proposes to implement the creation of the Volkhov-Murmansk gas pipeline through a regulatory contract, that is, to provide a return on investment due to future tariffs for methane consumers in the Murmansk region and Karelia.

de: Analyst at the Institute for Comprehensive Strategic Studies Elena Kiselyova advised employees planning to change their company in 2027 to first find a new place and only then quit.

d: Неспособность сотрудника отключиться от работы во время отпуска далеко не всегда связана с чувством ответственности — за ней нередко стоит страх потерять контроль или обнаружить, что без него прекрасно справляются.
te: Shchedrov expert: employee’s leave is a test of the company’s maturity
de: The inability of an employee to disconnect from work during a vacation is not always associated with a sense of responsibility - it is often the fear of losing control or finding that they cope perfectly without it.
